# Best waterproof Bluetooth speakers for the pool or beach

For most people, the **JBL Charge 6** is the best choice. Several tested guides rank it first, and it has the highest water and dust rating in the group. My picks by use:

| Need | Pick | Why | Price in the sources |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Best overall** | JBL Charge 6 | IP68, 20 hr battery (28 with Playtime Boost), 40W, doubles as a power bank. What Hi-Fi and BestProducts both rank it #1. | ~$130-$150 |
| **Loudest, for pool parties** | JBL Boombox 4 | RTINGS' top waterproof pick. It floats, survives long immersion, and lasts 40+ hours. Its sound is directional, so it's best when you're in front of it. | Not listed |
| **360° sound, floats** | Ultimate Ears Epicboom | IP67 and floats. Sound is the same wherever you sit. Tom's Guide's #1, RTINGS' mid-range pick. Battery is about 15 hr. | Not listed |
| **Budget** | Ultimate Ears Wonderboom 4 | IP67, floats, 14 hr battery, small and tough. | ~$65-$80 |
| **Cheapest and tiny** | JBL Go 5 | IP67, soap-sized, but only about 8 hr battery. | ~$40 |
| **Big sound for the money** | Soundcore Boom 2 Plus | IPX7, floats, up to 20 hr (with lights off), 100 W. It weighs 3.8 kg (about 8.4 lb). | $249.99 list, $200 with code AFSC20 |

**Where to buy** (I can't browse, so these are the review pages, each with current price buttons for Amazon, Walmart, Best Buy and others):
- JBL Charge 6, Go 5: [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart) or [BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)
- JBL Boombox 4, Ultimate Ears Epicboom, Wonderboom 4: [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)
- Epicboom (also): [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers)
- Soundcore Boom 2 Plus: [buy at Soundcore's US store via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-2-plus). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you. They report that code AFSC20 took $49.99 off in a cart test on 2026-10-22, but the store's checkout has the final word. Its listing also gives conflicting Bluetooth versions (6.0 vs 5.3).

**Tips for the pool and beach:**
- Aim for **IP67 or higher**. IP68 gives a bit more margin.
- If you want it to float, check that specifically. Only the Boombox 4, Epicboom, Wonderboom 4 and Boom 2 Plus are confirmed floaters in these sources. The Charge 6's floating isn't stated.
- IP ratings don't cover **salt or chlorine corrosion**. RTINGS suggests rinsing with fresh water after use (check your manual first), and itechguides adds to keep the charging port flap closed and let the speaker dry fully before charging.
- At the beach, keep it on a towel rather than in the sand. Good Housekeeping and BestProducts both note dust can be an issue. The Boom 2 (non-Plus) has no dust rating.

If you tell me your budget and whether you want something pocketable or a party-sized speaker, I can narrow it to one.
